verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a first-party official MCP server (dynadot-docs-5,6,19,20,26; confirmed by probe dynadot-probe-3) that lets an AI assistant check availability, register domains, view account info, and review DNS/nameservers via MCP. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no detail on authentication/tool-scoping breadth.
